context: Iwate countryside. The visiting urban doctor Saito is doing weekly rounds at the small clinic; today Tatsuya has come in for the first time in two years.
purpose: rural patient, city doctor — quiet diagnostic encounter

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: こんにちは。今日は、どんなことで？
lines.en: Hello. What brings you in today?
lines.style: Warm, measured greeting. Sits down first. Clear eye contact. Ready to listen without rushing.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: いや…ちょっと、息切れな。
lines.en: Well… a bit of shortness of breath.
lines.style: Quiet, deliberate. Pauses before answering like he's weighing whether to say it out loud. Rural cadence, Tohoku rhythm. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いつ頃から、気になるようになりました？
lines.en: When did you start noticing it?
lines.style: Clinical but not cold. Pen poised. Voice is practical, focused. No emotional weight added — just gathering information.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Heavy pause before the number. Words come slow. Each one lands with the weight of half a year of silence. Minimal, honest.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 半年ね…。本当に、その間、誰にも言わずに？
lines.en: Six months… and really — you didn't mention it to anyone all that time?
lines.style: No trace of judgment. Gentle surprise, genuine concern underneath. Leans forward slightly. The question is care, not criticism.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 畑も、やらにゃならんし。
lines.en: There's the fields to tend — can't let them go.
lines.style: Plain statement of fact. Not defensive, not self-pitying. The voice of someone for whom work comes before complaint. Rural practicality.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。…少し、ちゃんと診せていただいて、いいですか？
lines.en: I see. …May I give you a proper examination?
lines.style: Respectful, almost deferential. Asks permission as though speaking to the elder. Warm but professional. Dignified.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Agreement given. Sits up slightly — a small physical permission. Tohoku-simple. Trust settling in.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 時間、少し取ります。心配しないで、まず深呼吸。
lines.en: I'll need a bit of time. Don't worry — let's start with a deep breath.
lines.style: Professional warmth in motion. Voice steady and kind, firm without urgency. Reassuring. In control.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Quiet gratitude. Tohoku formal-gentle. The words are simple but sincere. A small moment of trust made visible.
